info.name: Document AI API
info.description:
DocumentAI API collection, generated from docs/documentai-api/openapi.json.

Quick start (local dev):
1. Start the API: `cd documentai-api && cp local.env.example .env && make init && make start` (serves http://localhost:8000).
2. This collection sends `API-Key: {{apiKey}}` on every request; the default matches the local dev key.
3. Admin (`/v1/admin/*`) routes require a Cognito JWT and will 401/403 with only the API key.

Regenerate with `make postman`.
